description: Variations are alternative versions of a campaign's email, compared side by side on the editor's Canvas tab. They never change what the campaign sends until use_campaign_variation. Labels: V1, V2, ... for versions of the email, V2.1, V2.2, ... for branches of V2. Lists the campaign's variations oldest first with status (generating, ready, failed), parentId (nearest variation it descends from that is not discarded), blocks, emailTheme and fontFamily (its own look, or null for the email's), position (where the user placed it on the canvas, or null), and inUse (the email currently has exactly this content). Discarded variations are not listed. Poll this after generate_campaign_variations until no variation is generating; one still generating after 10 minutes is reported as failed.
